content.text:
I fixed the pricing page. The "Most popular" ribbon on the Pro plan had `z-index: -1` in `site/css/pages.css`, which put it behind the card's background so it was hidden or clipped. I changed it to `z-index: 1`, and it now shows above the card.

The 16 functional tests pass. I didn't look at the page in a browser, and the tests don't check the ribbon, so I haven't seen it render. The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't check which change introduced this. I found the cause by reading the CSS.

If something else on the page looks off, tell me what and I'll look at that too.

STATUS: DONE
